Action bar

.dr-actionbar · [hidden] · components/shell.css · kit specimen

Anatomy

Submit review Book again
  1. 1.dr-actionbarThe bar: --bg-page ground, 1px --border-hairline on top, padding 12 16 24, a column with gap 8.
  2. 2.dr-btn--primaryThe screen's one green control, full width: 341 at the 375 frame.
  3. 3.dr-btn--secondaryEvery other action, on its own row, the same width.

Variants and sizes

Inventory rows: Action bar.

States

No state of its own: the bar is a container and nothing in it takes focus but the controls it holds. Its buttons take the button states, and the composer's message field takes the field states.

When to use

The action bar is the bottom edge of a pushed screen: where the screen's job is committed. It replaces the tab bar of the screen shell; 87 of the 133 pages in wireframes/ draw it. Of those, 35 hold one button, 38 a stack, 4 the chat composer, 5 a note only, and 5 the call controls of the call surface (call, call-aerial, call-client, call-inspection, call-support). Every button in it is filled and full width, stacked one per row. Text-only rungs (tertiary, text) live in the nav bar, never here.

While the onscreen keyboard is up the bar takes [hidden] and leaves; buttons drawn behind the keys while still in the tab order would fail WCAG 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured. A screen with nothing to commit ends at </main> and draws no bar: earning-details, notifications, role-select and listings-filters, for example. The tab roots draw no bar either; they carry the tab bar.

The primary is on top in every action bar (designer, rev 290): the screen's job first, the way out under it, in the markup as well as on screen. Drawers stack Done over Cancel the same way (rev 291); the finder keeps Filters over Find, her own call. Labels name the outcome and state a price before the tap: Pay ₴180, Submit review, Contact support, Try again.

Sources: DESIGN.md § Navigation · voice.md P1, P3 · microcopy.md § Master table · inventory.md § 1 (Action bar)

Rule and anti-rule

Do

Submit report Submit without evidence

report-issue: the main job as the primary, the way out as a secondary under it, each on its own full-width row.

Don’t

Submit report

A text-only rung in the bar. No screen builds this: every button in an action bar is filled and full width. Cancel belongs in the nav bar as a tertiary button, or in the bar as a secondary under the primary. For a choice between routes rather than a commitment, use choice cards in the column, not a stack of buttons in the bar.
